name: Scope Clarifier
description: Force explicit boundaries; identify 'out-of-scope'. Ensure the goal is narrow and achievable.

name: Investigator
description: Find existing patterns, constraints, and dependencies. Research the current state to avoid duplicating work.

name: Plan Enricher
description: Expand the 'what' into a concrete 'how'. Detail the steps, data flow, and logic.

name: User Approval Gate
description: Stop for human review of the enriched plan.

name: Architect
description: Define components, interfaces, and data flow. Design the structural skeleton.

name: Abstraction Lifter
description: Move from concrete implementation to systemic patterns. Raise the level of the design.

name: Complexity Calmer
description: Cut 'just-in-case' abstractions; return to KISS. Prune any over-engineering.

name: Plan Verifier
description: Cross-check the architecture against the initial scope and the enriched plan.

name: Test Designer
description: Define the 'Green' state. Write the test cases, inputs, and expected assertions.

name: Test Critic
description: Find gaps in the test design. Hunt for edge cases and failure modes.

name: Alignment Judge
description: Decision Point: If test gaps are found, rewind to 'plan-enricher'. Otherwise, proceed.

name: TDD Red
description: Write the failing test code. Implement the test check first.

name: Minimum Implementation
description: Write the absolute minimum code needed to make the test pass.

name: TDD Green
description: Refine the implementation until the test passes and the logic is sound.

name: TDD Refactor
description: Clean the code without changing behavior. Apply General Coding laws.

name: TDD Loop Judge
description: Decision Point: If more tests are required, rewind to 'tdd-red'. Otherwise, proceed.

name: Plan Auditor
description: Verify: 'Did we build what we planned in the enriched plan?'

name: Spec Auditor
description: Verify: 'Does the result satisfy the original AOP engine specification?'

name: Coverage Auditor
description: Verify: 'Is every logical branch covered by the test suite?'

name: Final Synthesizer
description: Package the final result, polished and aligned.
